extracted.intended_audience: recipients of Federal financial assistance (IHEs, LEAs, other recipients), Title IX coordinators, compliance officers, institutional legal counsel, and stakeholders responding to Title IX rulemaking
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts and states the regulatory definitions, obligations, and analytic standards in the Department of Education's final Title IX regulations (part 106), including definitions of key terms, recordkeeping requirements, and small-entity regulatory-flexibility definitions used to assess impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of Part 106
rubrics_metrics.description: The purpose of this part is to effectuate Title IX, which is designed to eliminate (with certain exceptions) discrimination on the basis of sex in any education program or activity receiving Federal financial assistance. This part is also intended to effectuate section 844 of the Education Amendments of 1974.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the substantive objective that informs all regulatory obligations and limits any exceptions; frames later obligations (prevent/address sex discrimination, ensure access, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Administrative law judge
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative law judge means a person appointed by the reviewing authority to preside over a hearing held under § 106.81.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies who may preside over formal hearings under the specified grievance/hearing provision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Administratively separate unit
rubrics_metrics.description: Administratively separate unit means a school, department, or college of an educational institution (other than a local educational agency), admission to which is independent of admission to any other component of such institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to determine when subunits of an institution constitute separate covered programs/activities for Title IX purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Admission
rubrics_metrics.description: Admission means selection for part-time, full-time, special, associate, transfer, exchange, or any other enrollment, membership, or matriculation in or at an education program or activity operated by a recipient.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the term for application to enrollment/admissions-related nondiscrimination obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant, as used in the definition of educational institution in this section and as used in § 106.4, means one who submits an application, request, or plan required to be approved by a Department official, or by a recipient, as a condition to becoming a recipient.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies who is treated as an applicant for regulatory purposes (e.g., programs seeking federal funds).

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Assistant Secretary
rubrics_metrics.description: Assistant Secretary means the Assistant Secretary for Civil Rights of the Department.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the Department official referenced elsewhere in the part.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Complainant
rubrics_metrics.description: Complainant means: (1) A student or employee who is alleged to have been subjected to conduct that could constitute sex discrimination under Title IX or this part; or (2) A person other than a student or employee who is alleged to have been subjected to conduct that could constitute sex discrimination under Title IX or this part and who was participating or attempting to participate in the recipient's education program or activity at the time of the alleged sex discrimination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies who qualifies as a complainant for purposes of grievance procedures and supportive measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Complaint
rubrics_metrics.description: Complaint means an oral or written request to the recipient that objectively can be understood as a request for the recipient to investigate and make a determination about alleged discrimination under Title IX or this part.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes the standard for what constitutes a complaint (objective standard), including oral complaints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Confidential employee
rubrics_metrics.description: Confidential employee means: (1) An employee of a recipient whose communications are privileged or confidential under Federal or State law (status limited to scope of duties where privilege applies); (2) An employee of a recipient whom the recipient has designated as confidential under this part for the purpose of providing services to persons related to sex discrimination (status limited to information received about sex discrimination while providing those services); or (3) An employee of a postsecondary institution conducting an IRB-approved human-subjects research study designed to gather information about sex discrimination (status limited to information received while conducting the study).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains three categories that may receive ‘confidential’ designation and limits of that confidentiality for Title IX purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Department
rubrics_metrics.description: Department means the Department of Education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the federal agency responsible for administering and enforcing the regulations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Disciplinary sanctions
rubrics_metrics.description: Disciplinary sanctions means consequences imposed on a respondent following a determination under Title IX that the respondent violated the recipient's prohibition on sex discrimination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used when describing sanctions that may follow from findings under the grievance procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Educational institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Educational institution means a local educational agency (LEA) as defined by section 8101 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act, a preschool, a private elementary or secondary school, or an applicant or recipient that is an institution of graduate higher education, undergraduate higher education, professional education, or vocational education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the sweep of institutions covered by the regulation's protections and obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Federal financial assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal financial assistance means any of the following when authorized or extended under a law administered by the Department: (1) grants or loans including funds for buildings and scholarships; (2) grants of Federal real or personal property or proceeds of sale/transfer when Federal share not properly accounted; (3) provision of services of Federal personnel; (4) sale/lease of Federal property at nominal/reduced consideration or permission to use Federal property without consideration; (5) any other contract/agreement/arrangement with purpose of providing assistance to any education program or activity (except insurance/guaranty).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates funding/property/service categories that trigger Title IX obligations for recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Parental status
rubrics_metrics.description: Parental status means the status of a person who is a biological parent, adoptive parent, foster parent, stepparent, legal custodian or guardian, in loco parentis, or actively seeking legal custody/guardianship/visitation/adoption of a person under age 18 or an adult incapable of self-care.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies who is covered by parental-status protections referenced in certain sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Party
rubrics_metrics.description: Party means a complainant or respondent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple definitional term used throughout grievance procedure provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Peer retaliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer retaliation means retaliation by a student against another student.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies retaliation by students distinct from retaliation by recipients or employees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Pregnancy or related conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Pregnancy or related conditions means: (1) pregnancy, childbirth, termination of pregnancy, or lactation; (2) medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, termination of pregnancy, or lactation; or (3) recovery from pregnancy, childbirth, termination of pregnancy, lactation, or related medical conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to define the scope of protections and recipient responsibilities concerning pregnancy-related accommodations and nondiscrimination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Program or activity / program
rubrics_metrics.description: Program or activity and program means all of the operations of—(1) a department, agency, special purpose district, or other instrumentality of a State or local government; or the entity of a State/local government that distributes assistance and each department/agency to which assistance is extended; (2) a college, university, or other postsecondary institution, or a public system of higher education; or a local educational agency, system of vocational education, or other school system; (3) an entire corporation/partnership/private organization/sole proprietorship if assistance is extended to such entity as a whole or which is principally engaged in providing education/healthcare/housing/social services/parks; or the entire plant/facility receiving assistance; or (4) any other entity established by two or more of the entities described above, any part of which is extended Federal financial assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies what operations/count as a recipient’s covered program or activity for Title IX obligations; used to determine the scope of application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Recipient means any State or political subdivision thereof, or any instrumentality of a State or political subdivision thereof, any public or private agency, institution, or organization, or other entity, or any person, to whom Federal financial assistance is extended directly or through another recipient and which operates an education program or activity which receives such assistance, including any subunit, successor, assignee, or transferee thereof.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines who is obligated by the regulations (broad sweep to include many entity types and subunits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement: Recordkeeping under §106.8(f)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final § 106.8(f) requires a recipient to maintain certain documentation related to Title IX activities; the Department estimates increased recordkeeping burden (Year 1: additional 4 hours per LEA, 16 hours per IHE, 4 hours per other recipient; ongoing: 2 hours per LEA, 6 hours per IHE, 2 hours per other recipient).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies that recipients must preserve records related to Title IX activities and quantifies the Department's burden estimates; note that Department believes no change in disclosure requirements for most recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Relevant (evidence/questions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Relevant means related to the allegations of sex discrimination under investigation as part of the grievance procedures under § 106.45 (and if applicable § 106.46). Questions are relevant when they seek evidence that may aid in showing whether the alleged sex discrimination occurred, and evidence is relevant when it may aid a decisionmaker in determining whether the alleged sex discrimination occurred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the standard for what evidence and questioning are permissible in investigations/hearings under the grievance procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Remedies
rubrics_metrics.description: Remedies means measures provided, as appropriate, to a complainant or any other person the recipient identifies as having had their equal access to the recipient's education program or activity limited or denied by sex discrimination. These measures are provided to restore or preserve that person's access to the recipient's education program or activity after a recipient determines that sex discrimination occurred.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies the purpose of remedies (restoring/preserving access) and their targeted beneficiaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Respondent
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent means a person who is alleged to have violated the recipient's prohibition on sex discrimination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used throughout the grievance process to identify the individual accused of discrimination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition: Retaliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Retaliation means intimidation, threats, coercion, or discrimination against any person by the recipient, a student, or an employee or other person authorized by the recipient to provide aid, benefit, or service under the recipient's education program or activity, for the purpose of interfering with any right or privilege secured by Title IX or this part, or because the person has reported information, made a complaint, testified, assisted, or participated or refused to participate in any manner in an investigation, proceeding, or hearing under this part, including in an informal resolution process under § 106.44(k), in grievance procedures under § 106.45 (and if applicable § 106.46), and in any other actions taken by a recipient under § 106.44(f)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broadly prohibits retaliation by recipients, students, or employees in response to protected activity and ties the prohibition to specific grievance/informal processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: RFA: Small IHE definition (enrollment-based)
rubrics_metrics.description: For purposes of the final regulations' Regulatory Flexibility Analysis, 'small IHE' is defined as (1) a less-than-two-year IHE with an enrollment of fewer than 750 students, or (2) an at-least-two-year-but-less-than-four-year IHE, or a four-year institution, with enrollment of fewer than 1,000 students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Department uses enrollment (rather than SBA revenue) to identify small IHEs for RFA analysis; justifies approach and notes ~61% of IHEs would be classified as small under this standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: RFA: Small LEA definition
rubrics_metrics.description: For RFA purposes, 'small LEA' means either (1) a traditional public school district located in a county with a total population of less than 50,000, or (2) a charter school LEA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as a proxy for SBA small-government definition; treats charter school LEAs as small due to average size/geographic limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessible format availability
rubrics_metrics.description: On request to the program contact person listed under FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT, individuals with disabilities can obtain this document in an accessible format (e.g., RTF, txt, thumb drive, MP3, braille, large print, audiotape, CD, or other accessible format).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obligation to provide accessible formats on request; procedural point for dissemination and public participation.
